# InclusiFund

> InclusiFund is a UK funding ecosystem focused on grassroots community organisations — specifically CICs (Community Interest Companies), small charities, and community-run businesses that sit below the £1M income threshold where most institutional funding stops looking. We pair grant-matching and application-writing services with building tools (websites, director dashboards, content systems) for the same operators. The worldview is set out at /manifesto; the impact ledger at /receipts. AntiGravity Projects is the build arm (web agency / digital studio) that delivers the technology side.

_Grants, tools, and a community for people building CICs, charities, and community-run businesses in the UK. Built neurodiverse-first._

## What We Do

- Grant-matching for CICs, small charities, and community-run businesses
- Grant application writing
- Website builds (AntiGravity Projects build arm)
- Director dashboards and operational tools
- Content systems
- CIC toolkit (eligibility, compliance, grant-finder) at tools.inclusifund.co.uk
- AI fluency assessment at aiq.inclusifund.co.uk
- Member community at community.inclusifund.co.uk

## Pricing

- Model: Free community and tools; grant-writing and web/technology builds delivered as paid services.

## Location & Hours

- Email: reece.dunn@inclusifund.co.uk
- Service area: United Kingdom

## FAQ

### Who is InclusiFund for?
UK grassroots community organisations — CICs (Community Interest Companies), small charities, and community-run businesses, especially those below the £1M income threshold where most institutional funding stops looking.

### What does InclusiFund actually do?
We pair grant-matching and application-writing with building the tools those operators need — websites, director dashboards, and content systems. AntiGravity Projects is our build arm that delivers the technology side.

### Who runs InclusiFund?
InclusiGroup Ltd is the registered company; InclusiFund is the brand. Founder: Reece Dunn. Contact: reece.dunn@inclusifund.co.uk.

### What are the related InclusiFund surfaces?
studio.inclusifund.co.uk (portfolio + studio landing pages), aiq.inclusifund.co.uk (AI fluency assessment), community.inclusifund.co.uk (member community), and tools.inclusifund.co.uk (the CIC toolkit).
